scope: A disposable Kubernetes v1.36.1 Kind control plane writes a native Metadata-level audit event for one case-owned ConfigMap create. The case preserves that exact JSONL record and stores identical bytes in an unlocked S3 version and a version inheriting a synthetic three-day COMPLIANCE bucket default. The S3 API observations verify the configured default, effective per-version retention, successful deletion of the unlocked counterpart, denial of early protected-version deletion or shortening, and exact-version retrieval after a benign replacement. This tests the pinned Versity gateway data plane only; it does not establish production log coverage, provider equivalence, legal retention requirements, administrative separation, storage capacity, or sustained durability.

checks.claim: The bucket default is COMPLIANCE and its effective version retention meets the synthetic required window
The identical pre-default unlocked audit version can be deleted early
Early protected-version deletion and retention shortening are denied
Original exact audit bytes remain retrievable by version ID after a benign replacement
